description: This file defines the InboxTableConfigResolver class, which configures and manages the notification inbox table, including fetching notifications, handling user actions like marking notifications as read, and displaying notification details in a dialog.

classes.name: InboxTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service class that provides configuration for the notifications inbox table, including data fetching, user interactions, and UI components.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig object for notifications.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up cell action descriptors, such as marking a notification as read.

methods.name: markAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read and refreshes the table.

methods.name: markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read and updates the table accordingly.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Opens a dialog to display notification details and marks it as read if needed.
